# Practice Portal

> A practice tool for bands. Each song is split into stems, one audio file per part, so a musician can solo, mute or turn down any part and play along with the rest of the band. Sheet music and lyrics scroll in time with the audio, the tempo can be slowed without changing pitch, and bands keep set lists for their gigs.

New bands are Members only: their songs are visible to the band's signed-in members and to anyone holding the band's guest link. A band can choose to be Public. Accounts use Google sign-in.

## Pages

- [Home](https://practiceportal.app/): what Practice Portal is, and sign up
- [Help](https://practiceportal.app/help): guides to using Practice Portal
- [Roles and permissions](https://practiceportal.app/help/roles-and-permissions): the roles in a band, from Owner to Guest, and what each can do
- [Start your band](https://practiceportal.app/help/start-your-band): create a band, add your first song and bring your bandmates in
- [Practicing a song](https://practiceportal.app/help/practicing-a-song): play, loop, slow down, jump to a section, sheet music and lyrics
- [Using the mixer](https://practiceportal.app/help/using-the-mixer): turn parts up or down, mute and solo them, keep your mix
- [Notes on songs](https://practiceportal.app/help/notes): leave notes at a moment in a song for the whole band
- [Keyboard shortcuts](https://practiceportal.app/help/keyboard-shortcuts): every shortcut in the player and the editors
- [Adding and editing songs](https://practiceportal.app/help/adding-songs): upload stems and sheet music, group parts, change a song later
- [Timing and lyrics](https://practiceportal.app/help/timing-and-lyrics): mark sections and measures, sync lyrics
- [Setlists and collections](https://practiceportal.app/help/setlists): build sets for a gig, group songs into collections, and share them
- [Troubleshooting and FAQ](https://practiceportal.app/help/faq): common questions
- [Privacy Policy](https://practiceportal.app/legal/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://practiceportal.app/legal/terms)
